FASTVC-BENCH-CORPUS:chromium-main-v1-943b94ae-1c74-4335-94fa-ceb4d277cea8
Test that calling play() and pause() triggers async play, timeupdate and pause events.

RUN(video.play())
RUN(video.pause())
SCRIPT DONE
EVENT(play)
EXPECTED (video.paused == 'true') OK
EVENT(timeupdate)
EXPECTED (video.paused == 'true') OK
EVENT(pause)
EXPECTED (video.paused == 'true') OK
END OF TEST
